input: only saved original-G seven/eight-dimensional Schur blocks and the saved full-G t=4 reference
analytic_parameter: H(lambda)=[[A,b],[lambda*c,d]], lambda=0 or 1 only; source resolvent feedback scales by lambda
parameter_scope: a Schur feedback bookkeeping parameter, not a new positive Markov process or best-fit model
slow_contribution: L=r*exp(z*t), z=-mass; compare endpoint pole and source residue without refitting
additive_decomposition: Delta L = mean(r)*Delta exp(z*t) + mean(exp(z*t))*Delta r; exact symmetric two-factor attribution
remainder: Delta total correlation minus Delta slow contribution, retaining all other modes
derivatives: analytic spectral-projector derivatives at lambda=0 and 1 only
